params.body:
## What

The film on `/stories` now uses the hero of the collection pages, so Stories and Couture look alike when you go from one to the other.

- **Height.** The hero fills the screen, as on Couture: 900px on a 1440x900 screen instead of 558px.
- **Title.** "Stories" sits bottom left at 48px, like "HOET COUTURE", instead of 74px inside a 1200px column.
- **Path.** The "Home / Stories" path above the title is gone. The breadcrumb markup for search engines stays.
- **Line under the title.** It has the font and size of "Uniek & Tijdloos" on Couture, 24px instead of 17px.
- **Intro.** The fallback intro drops "made in Belgium", which every story already says. It reads "Over ambachtelijk meesterschap, onze collecties en duurzame brillen.", in all four languages. An intro set in the Studio (Stories, Inleiding) still wins.

The `rb-hero--stories` variant and the `crumbs` option of the hero block had no other user and are removed, along with the `Kruimelpad` translation.

## Checked

- Full suite: 484 tests, 482 pass. `BuildStampTest` fails in any git worktree, also on main. The second failure was the `Kruimelpad` key that the change left unused; after removing it, `VertalingenTest`, `StoriesTest` and `BlogTest` (28 tests) pass. Pint passes.
- Measured locally next to Couture, on desktop and mobile: same height, same title and subtitle position and size.
params.title: Give Stories the hero of the collection pages
